description: Scenario definition for the TSM Level-5 flood simulator (tsm-console/src/lib/flood-sim). Historical-data honesty is enforced structurally: every scenario declares source, provenance, humanReviewRequired, and an explicit provisionalFields list.

gaugeDriven.description: True: rainfall comes from live REST gauge polling at runtime; hyetograph must be null.

seed.description: Deterministic seed; strings are hashed via FNV-1a (seedFromString).

humanReviewRequired.description: Must be true: simulation outputs inform; human authority remains final.

provenance.description: Repo provenance taxonomy layer for the scenario definition itself. Engine outputs are always 'simulation'.

provisional.description: True when any field is provisional (unverified / illustrative / user-supplied).

provisionalFields.description: Explicit list of every provisional field. Empty only when provisional=false.

scenarioId.description: Stable kebab-case id, also used to derive the deterministic PRNG seed.

source.description: Citation for the scenario's factual basis (file path + line, URL, or 'operator-supplied').

sourcedValues.description: Numeric values with a verifiable source. Everything NOT listed here is provisional or computed.

title: Flood Simulator Scenario
